dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from high-intensity light-grey edges to low-intensity dark cores. A prominent large macro-annulus on the mid-dorsal surface shows a scalloped exterior boundary with a clear internal-external contrast ratio.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical, solid light-pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily along the lower lateral flank and the anterior neck region. These clusters appear as localized high-intensity pixel groups against the dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the largest dorsal annulus and two neighboring lateral 'C' structures form an obtuse triangle. A series of smaller blob centroids create a roughly linear sequence following the longitudinal axis of the lower flank.

other_distinctive_markers: An abrupt, sharp contrast boundary is visible at the neck fold where the light textural patterns terminate against a solid dark region of the head.
